reasons: Datadog postgresql.connections (the number of open connections per database) maps to OTel postgresql.backends, which measures the same quantity: the number of backends per database. Both are point-in-time counts, so no rate is needed and the non-monotonic sum is selected correctly.
Grouping by db maps to the observed dataset label postgresql_database_name, not the absent db_namespace, which is the required label name in this dataset.
avg by (...) matches the Datadog avg aggregation with by {db}. The $scope variable has no prefix and defaults to *, so it is correctly dropped.
The request is translated, and an exact translation exists, so the outcome is correct.
